summary: Reacts to a GameEvent asset with an Inspector-wired response. No code for simple cases.
overview: Drop it on whatever should react, assign the event asset and wire the response in the Inspector. For anything simple — play a sound, show a panel, disable an object — that is the whole integration.
useCases: Showing a game-over screen when a death event is raised.
Triggering audio or VFX from a gameplay event without a script.
Letting a designer hook a new reaction without a programmer.

params.tuning: One listener per event. To react to two events, add two components.

gotchas.title: It only listens while enabled
gotchas.body: Registration happens in OnEnable and unregisters in OnDisable, so a disabled object misses events entirely rather than queueing them.
